worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.summary: Crouch and press the earth underfoot, then split a seam toward the target: stone spikes drive out of the ground along it in segments. Whoever stands on the ridge band is stabbed from below, the first foe takes full power and later foes on the same ridge take less; the broken ground stays a while and closes again. The scattered form widens the ridge to catch a rank, the sharp form is one narrow seam.
Each foe standing on the ridge band is stabbed only once; the first takes about %1$s Rock physical damage. The band is %2$s blocks half-wide.
The seam runs %1$s blocks from the caster and drives out as %2$s spike segments.
Later foes on the same ridge keep %1$s of the power, and the broken ground lingers for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.stance.wide: Scattered form: the band widens 1.8x with two more segments, so one seam catches a rank; the cost is 0.9x power, a shorter seam and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.stance.sharp: Sharp form: one narrow, longer seam at 1.06x power and 1.1x range, made to impale a single target on the line; the cost is narrow coverage.
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.growth.0: From level %1$s the spikes rise to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.growth.1: From level %1$s the spikes rise to %2$s and the seam extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.use.0: Impale a target on one seam
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.use.1: Open from a distance and push a position apart
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.use.2: Leave a crack that closes itself
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.preference.w: On: the band widens 1.8x with two more segments so one seam catches a rank, at 0.9x power, a shorter seam and a longer wind-up and cooldown. Off: the sharp form, one narrow longer seam at 1.06x power and 1.1x range that only stabs what stands on the line.
worldcombat.skill.stoneedge.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of splitting. Larger values open from further out, giving the target more time to step off the band.
On: past 60% of its range it splits first, pushing a distant target back. Off: it treats the move as a normal attack and splits even up close.
